analysis_contract.independent_unit: one development world and its two-context response pair
analysis_contract.primary_test: one-sided exact sign test conditional on non-tie worlds
analysis_contract.private_key_load_time: only after a complete 48-call generation bundle passes public-only validation
analysis_contract.world_signed_score: sum of two own-context correct-option indicators minus sum of two cross-context correct-option indicators

joint_exchangeability.joint_observable_tuple: received_or_transport_status, received-content validity, and parsed opaque choice when valid
joint_exchangeability.known_limit: the protocol and small target-free canary can rule out obvious implementation drift but cannot empirically prove the scientific exchangeability assumption
joint_exchangeability.null_hypothesis: without context utilization, the joint observable outcomes are invariant to exchanging the two context-arm labels within a world
protocol_justification: each arm is a fresh stateless one-shot request to the same route
both arms use identical model, sampling, token, thinking, schema, timeout and no-retry settings
within each formal pair the action order, opaque options, D0, parent and wording are shared
the provider receives only rendered prompt bytes and never receives pair or arm labels
the phase order is fixed before model output and balanced within every construction stratum
the target-free paired canary checks the same two-arm dispatch and observable-status recording path for obvious implementation or route asymmetry

response_and_failure_policy.received_invalid_world_treatment: if either arm is received-invalid, the entire world is a primary tie and a complete-switch miss in the fixed denominator
response_and_failure_policy.route_response_contract_drift_treatment: the complete primary route attempt is non-evaluable
response_and_failure_policy.transport_missing_HTTP_or_payload_failur: the complete primary route attempt is non-evaluable; no partial denominator, replacement, fallback or resume
response_and_failure_policy.valid_received_content: one JSON object with exactly one expression field whose string value is one opaque option listed in that task prompt
